comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Same root cause as #111 — a virtual-list race in `TreeListView.MakeListViewItem` that throws `ArgumentOutOfRangeException` when the tree model changes mid-redraw. It was fixed after your build (**1.81.0-beta.4, build 3411**); the guard for this exact exception landed in builds after that (#52 / #56) and ships in every current nightly.

Please update to the latest nightly: https://github.com/robertpopa22/mRemoteNG/releases/tag/nightly — and reopen if it still occurs on a current build. Closing as...
